title: evidence-bundle/v2
description: A portable, gate-checkable record of HOW REAL a set of claims about a code change was verified. One bundle per change; one entry per claim. Each claim asserts a rung (how real: 0 not-runtime-observed, 1 observed), a method (how evaluated: single/differential/adversarial/fuzz/property), and a context (who checked: author/independent); a deterministic gate reduces (bundle, policy) to a verdict and can only ever lower trust relative to what the bundle claims. Every field here is either gate-enforced or advisory documentation; a schema-valid bundle is NOT necessarily gate-passing, because the gate enforces conditional requirements the schema cannot express. rung 1 requires at least one artifact; method=differential requires both s0_capture and s1_capture artifacts plus a differential whose polarity is verified against the capture bytes; a required cross-model or cross-lab qualifier requires context=independent plus a matching attestation. See the README for the enforced-vs-advisory field table.

repo.description: Human description of the surface under change. May be redacted.

s0.description: Baseline ref (pre-change): the state the differential is measured AGAINST.

s1.description: Candidate ref (post-change): the state being verified.

model.description: Producing model. The cross-model qualifier is defined relative to this value.

lab.description: Producing lab/org. The cross-lab qualifier is defined relative to this value.

policy_pin.description: Advisory record of the exact policy bytes in force when `rung run` produced the bundle, so a verdict is attributable to that policy. Stamped by the producer; the gate ignores it (it re-reads and hashes the policy it is actually given).

rung.description: HOW REAL the verification was. 0=not a runtime observation of the real surface (read-only reasoning, unit import-and-call, test-suite green, and static/formal verification all collapse here; the shortfall is recorded as a gap, never a grade). 1=observed: drove the real surface (cli/server/gui/library/agent/ci) and captured its final behaviour. Separate from method and context.

method.description: HOW the observation was evaluated. Separate from rung and context. 'single'=one plain observation. 'differential'=drove the surface twice and captured an S0/S1 pair whose delta matches the declared polarity. ENFORCED: the gate byte-compares the captures and requires rung 1. 'adversarial'/'fuzz'/'property'=advisory stances, recorded and surfaced to a human reader but never gate-enforced (no mechanical anchor).

context.description: WHO evaluated, as a 2-value ladder of independence (weakest to strongest): author=the producer; independent=a blind reviewer that is not the producer and never saw the producer's reasoning/verdict. Separate from rung. A policy's require_context is satisfied by any context at least this independent. cross-model / cross-lab are NOT higher contexts. They are independence QUALIFIERS on an independent review, demanded by the policy's require_cross_model / require_cross_lab keys and carried in the attestation (a reviewer model/lab that differs from the producer, verdict=pass). Structural presence is not proof the review happened or was truly blind (judge-only / signing concern).

role.description: e.g. s0_capture, s1_capture, screenshot, response_body, log. method=differential requires both s0_capture and s1_capture.

uri.description: Path relative to the bundle (never absolute). The gate resolves it under the bundle dir, rejects any escape/symlink, size-caps the read, and hashes it. sha256 detects post-bundle MUTATION only; it is not evidence the file was produced by driving a real surface (that is judge-only).

sha256.description: Content hash, REQUIRED. The gate recomputes and rejects on mismatch or when absent for a required artifact.

probe.description: The exact action taken identically against S0 and S1.

attestation.description: Independent-review record carrying the independence QUALIFIERS. The gate enforces qualifier-conditional requirements the schema cannot express: a required cross-lab qualifier needs `lab` present and != change.producer.lab with verdict=pass; a required cross-model qualifier needs a `panel` (or a single `model`) naming >=1 reviewer model, each != change.producer.model, each verdict=pass. Both also require context=independent.

lab.description: Attesting lab. For a required cross-lab qualifier the gate requires this != change.producer.lab.

model.description: Reviewer model for a single-reviewer cross-model qualifier; the gate requires this != change.producer.model. For >1 reviewer use `panel`.

panel.description: Multi-reviewer cross-model panel. The gate requires every entry's model != change.producer.model and verdict=pass.

kind.description: The class of real consumer surface. Whether the thing driven IS the real surface (vs an internal proxy) is judge-only; the gate does not verify it.

expected_delta.description: Claim polarity, used by method=differential. 'change' (default): the change is meant to alter surface behaviour, so the differential must show S0!=S1. 'invariance': the change must NOT alter observable behaviour (refactor, dep bump, 'output unchanged', 'no network calls'), so the correct differential evidence is S0==S1 at the surface.

dismissed.description: An undismissed blocker gap blocks unless the policy sets allow_dismiss_gaps:true; a gap marked dismissed:true does not block.
